stories.story_fr: L'iPhone signe un record de chiffre d'affaires au trimestre de mars, porte par une demande qualifiee d'extraordinaire pour la gamme iPhone 17, signe d'un cycle de renouvellement vigoureux.
stories.story_en: iPhone set a March-quarter revenue record, fueled by what Apple called extraordinary demand for the iPhone 17 lineup, signaling a strong upgrade cycle.
stories.quote: iPhone achieved a March quarter revenue record, fueled by such extraordinary demand for the iPhone 17 lineup.

stories.story_fr: La base installee d'appareils actifs atteint un nouveau record absolu dans toutes les grandes categories de produits et toutes les zones geographiques, socle d'engagement qui alimente la croissance des Services.
stories.story_en: The installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments, an engagement base that fuels Services growth.
stories.signal: Base installee a un record absolu
stories.quote: Continued strong customer demand for our products and services once again helped us achieve a new all-time high for our installed base of active devices across all major product categories and geographic segments.

stories.story_fr: Les Services etablissent un nouveau record absolu de chiffre d'affaires au trimestre de mars, confirmant la montee en puissance du moteur recurrent a forte marge d'Apple.
stories.story_en: Services set yet another all-time revenue record in the March quarter, confirming the rise of Apple's high-margin recurring engine.
stories.quote: During the quarter, Services achieved yet another all-time record

stories.story_fr: Apple realise son meilleur trimestre de mars de son histoire avec une croissance a deux chiffres dans chaque zone geographique, illustrant une dynamique mondiale homogene.
stories.story_en: Apple delivered its best March quarter ever with double-digit growth across every geographic segment, illustrating broad-based global momentum.
stories.quote: Today Apple is proud to report our best March quarter ever, with revenue of $111.2 billion and double-digit growth across every geographic segment

stories.story_fr: Apple elargit sa gamme avec l'iPhone 17e, l'iPad Air motorise par la puce M4 et le lancement du MacBook Neo, renforcant son offre materielle la plus etoffee a ce jour.
stories.story_en: Apple broadened its lineup with the iPhone 17e, the M4-powered iPad Air, and the launch of MacBook Neo, strengthening its strongest hardware lineup yet.
stories.signal: Nouveaux produits MacBook Neo et iPhone 17e
stories.quote: That included the addition of the iPhone 17e and the M4-powered iPad Air, along with the launch of MacBook Neo, which is captivating customers all around the world.
